title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Post Sales
company: NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc.
description:
**Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers**

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting\-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.


**Your role at a glance**

The position for Senior Solutions Engineer – Post Sales provides technical support to all INDIA Region Solutions Engineering activities and is responsible for developing and delivering innovative and effective solutions that meet existing customer needs and drive business growth. This role is specifically focused on helping close existing hyperscale and enterprise business via data center and product knowledge, solution design, quoting, exceptional presentation skills, and leading tours of the NTT Data GDC facilities. The Senior Solutions Engineer will ensure the highest standards of technical excellence and customer satisfaction, contributing to the overall success of the organization. This role requires a technical oriented thinker with a deep understanding of infrastructure engineering as well as MEP systems, and customer requirements, who can build trust, and work collaboratively across various internal and external stakeholders.
**What we are looking for**

Key Roles and Responsibilities:


* Based in the INDIA region and reports to the Director of Central Solutions Engineering Services and works closely with NTT Data GDC Sales Representatives to develop a thorough understanding of existing customer technical requirements particularly electrical, mechanical, fiber network systems.
* Executes the technical solutioning of existing hyperscale/enterprise client requirements in alignment with NTT Data GDC company goals and objectives.
* Gathers existing client technical requirements and collaborates with other NTT Data GDC teams including Subject Matter Experts, Service Operations, Client Success Managers to oversee the development, design, and delivery of complex MEP, BMS, Fiber Network solutions, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality and performance.
* Leads the preparation of the technical response package for existing client requests and communicates solutions back to the client in a timely manner.
* Works with the Service Operations/Fitout teams to implement solutions in existing spaces.
* Demonstrates expert understanding of MEP, BMS, Fiber Networks data center design concepts and differentiators (liquid cooling, maintainable fault tolerant power, security redundancy, etc.).
* Supports NTT Data GDC Legal teams in contract and lease reviews, ensuring terms align with both the customer’s and NTT Data GDC requirements.
* Works closely with NTT sales representatives, product management, SMEs, operations, legal, and customer support teams to ensure seamless integration of solutions and successful project delivery.

KNOWLEDGE \& ATTRIBUTES


* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think strategically and make data\-driven decisions.
* Able to mark\-up electrical and mechanical single lines, as well as floor plan layouts of equipment and systems in AutoCAD, Bluebeam or other drafting software.
* A thorough understanding of modern data center and IT client topologies, design requirements, and environments with a primary focus on wholesale customers and their data center requirements.
* Proficient with software application such as AutoCAD, CFD Modeling, Visio, Word, Excel, Power Point, Project Outlook, SharePoint and Salesforce.
* Comfortable speaking/presenting to groups of all sizes.
* Able to work in a team/cross\-team/multi\-site environment.
* Manages stress and/or fast\-pace effectively.
* Excellent problem solver/creative thinker.
* Engages customers to extract critical technical and business drivers that may position client deliverables.
* Effective at working with 3rd party contractors and vendors to aid in the design of large customer infrastructure deployment requirements.
* Ability to develop and write a bill of materials and scope of work to meet large customer infrastructure deployment requirements.
* Maintains familiarity with competitive offerings to effectively position products and solutions in a competitive environment.
* Must possess effective oral and written communications and strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS \& CERTIFICATIONS


* Technical degree preferred

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE


* 15\+ years previous relevant experience in a similar technical role including pre\-sales support, design consulting, construction
* Previous technical post\-sales experience
* Experience dealing with stakeholders to influence sales

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS


* Primarily sitting with some walking, standing, and bending.
* Able to hear and speak into a telephone.
* Close visual work on a computer terminal.
* Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate any required to operate computer keyboard, mouse, and other technical instruments.
* Ability walk and lead technical tours throughout data center.

Work conditions \& other requirements


* Primarily remote, with occasional on\-site collaboration as required.
* Flexibility to work across global time zones.

Limited travel may be required (\~10%).


**Who we are**

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local\-to\-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI\-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

About Addend Analytics

Addend Analytics is a Microsoft Solutions Partner delivering Data Analytics, AI, Cloud, and ERP solutions to clients across the United States. We help organizations unlock business value through Microsoft technologies such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Dynamics 365, AI, and Data Engineering solutions.

Position

**Team Lead – Inside Sales (U.S. Market)**

**Location:** Kharghar, Navi Mumbai (Work From Office)

Work Shift

* **11:00 AM – 6:00 PM:** Office
* **9:00 PM – 11:00 PM:** Work From Home

We are looking for an experienced **Team Lead – Inside Sales** to lead our **Lead Generation and Demand Generation** initiatives for the U.S. market.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in **B2B outbound sales prospecting**, with hands\-on expertise in **cold calling, cold emailing, LinkedIn outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and multi\-channel outbound campaigns**. The primary objective of this role is to generate qualified sales opportunities, build a strong sales pipeline, and lead a high\-performing inside sales team responsible for demand generation.

This is a leadership role that combines **individual contribution and team management**. The candidate will actively drive outbound prospecting while mentoring the team, improving campaign performance, and ensuring a consistent flow of qualified meetings for the Business Development and Sales teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Inside Sales Executives to achieve lead generation and demand generation targets.
* Drive outbound prospecting campaigns across the U.S. market using:
* Cold Calling
* Cold Email Campaigns
* LinkedIn Outreach
* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Other outbound prospecting channels
* Identify target accounts and engage decision\-makers, including C\-level executives, Directors, and Business Heads.
* Generate high\-quality qualified leads and schedule meetings for the Sales and Business Development teams.
* Build and execute multi\-touch outreach sequences combining calls, emails, and LinkedIn interactions.
* Design and optimize outbound prospecting strategies to improve response rates, meeting conversions, and pipeline generation.
* Monitor team productivity, outreach quality, campaign effectiveness, and overall performance.
* Conduct regular coaching sessions on cold calling techniques, objection handling, email personalization, and LinkedIn prospecting.
* Ensure timely follow\-ups, accurate CRM updates, and proper lead qualification.
* Track pipeline health, campaign performance, meetings booked, and sales development KPIs.
* Collaborate with the Marketing and Pre\-Sales teams to improve campaign effectiveness, messaging, and lead quality.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on lead generation performance, pipeline contribution, and team productivity.

Required Experience

* **5–8 years** of experience in Inside Sales, Lead Generation, Demand Generation, Business Development, or Sales Development.
* **Minimum 2 years of experience selling to the U.S. market.**
* Proven experience managing or mentoring an Inside Sales, SDR, BDR, or Lead Generation team.
* Hands\-on experience in:
* Cold Calling
* Cold Emailing
* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* LinkedIn Outreach
* Outbound Sales Prospecting
* Appointment Setting
* Experience in IT Services, Software Services, SaaS, Cloud, AI, Data Analytics, ERP, or Technology Consulting is preferred.
* Candidates from other industries with strong U.S. outbound sales and lead generation experience are also encouraged to apply.

Skills Required

* Strong expertise in **Lead Generation, Demand Generation, and Inside Sales**.
* Excellent cold calling, consultative selling, and objection\-handling skills.
* Experience creating and executing cold email campaigns and outbound outreach sequences.
* Hands\-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and LinkedIn\-based prospecting.
* Strong understanding of outbound sales methodologies, account\-based prospecting, and pipeline generation.
* Experience using CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Microsoft Dynamics CRM, or similar platforms.
* Ability to analyze outreach metrics and improve campaign performance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.
* Analytical mindset with a focus on KPIs, conversion rates, and continuous process improvement.
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven, and results\-oriented.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Qualified Leads Generated
* Meetings Scheduled
* Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs)
* Pipeline Generated
* Cold Calling Productivity
* Email Campaign Performance
* LinkedIn Outreach Response Rate
* Team Activity Metrics
* Lead\-to\-Meeting Conversion Rate
* Team Target Achievement

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree in any Engineering discipline (B.E./B.Tech).

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience leading U.S. market outbound sales or demand generation teams.
* Hands\-on expertise with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Lusha, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar sales intelligence platforms.
* Strong understanding of B2B prospecting, account\-based outreach, and demand generation strategies.
* Ability to build and manage scalable outbound lead generation processes while consistently delivering high\-quality sales opportunities.

**Note:** Preference will be given to candidates residing in Navi Mumbai, as the role requires working in shifts.

* Paid time off

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Description**

 **Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

Wealth and Personal Banking (WPB) is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking, to become one of the world’s largest global wealth managers . Across Asia, where wealth pools are growing faster than in any other region, HSBC’s wealth revenues grew. Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra\-high\-net\-worth individuals. We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking that best suit our customers’ needs.

**Role Context**


The role sits within HSBC Contact Centre under IWPB, supporting inbound/outbound sales activity focused on converting generated leads to successful product/account openings.
The job holder operates in a structured, control\-heavy environment where customer understanding, explicit consent, accurate proposition mapping, and documentation completeness are essential to delivering compliant outcomes. Success in the role depends on strong communication, disciplined process execution, effective use of banking systems, and close coordination with partner teams to ensure smooth end\-to\-end lead management. **Principal Responsibilities**

* Cross\-sell leads generated, ensuring every sales opportunity is pursued and closed within defined parameters and process requirements.
* Confirm the customer’s intent to purchase and ensure they’ve fully understood the product.
* Complete sales confirmation by obtaining explicit customer authority on a recorded line after confirming product understanding.
* Identify and map customers to the right proposition before closing the sale (EWS, Premier, Personal Banking) based on employment and salary criteria.
* Follow defined processes and procedures as defined in the SOP
* Appropriate reporting for successfully opened accounts.
* Maintain accurate verification of customer details and eligibility, ensuring documentation completeness (including nominee information).
* Strictly follow scripts (EDRAS) and standard operating procedures, ensuring adherence to regulatory and internal requirements.
* Use multiple banking systems effectively (HUB, SFE, Whirl, Approach Tool, Kana, RMS, Media Bar) to support lead management and account opening.

 **Leadership**

* Engage customers professionally and empathetically, representing HSBC with strong service and sales discipline.
* Collaborate effectively with internal teams (e.g., Product, Contact Center) to ensure smooth lead progression, timely closures, and seamless account opening.
* Support a high\-performance environment by working efficiently in a high\-volume, fast\-paced setup and adapting to flexible shift schedules.

 **Operational Effectiveness \& Control**

* Ensure compliance by following EDRAS scripts, SOPs, and all regulatory/internal requirements throughout the sales and account\-opening journey.
* Maintain strong control over customer consent and confirmation steps (recorded authority \+ consent email confirmation).
* Protect customer information with the highest level of confidentiality and integrity.
* Deliver accurate, timely reporting and maintain process hygiene across systems and documentation.

 **Major Challenges**

* Managing high\-volume sales activity while maintaining accuracy in eligibility checks, documentation, and system updates.
* Securing explicit customer consent correctly (recorded line \+ consent email confirmation) without process deviations.
* Consistently matching customers to the correct proposition (EWS/Premier/Personal Banking) based on criteria, while meeting closure expectations.
* Operating across multiple systems and tools while maintaining speed, quality, and compliance.
* Balancing customer empathy and clarity with strict adherence to scripts and controls.

 **Role requirements / Educational Qualifications / Certification / Experience:*** **Years of Experience:** 1 to 5 years
* **Required Skill:** Consultative selling; clear \& empathetic communication; script adherence; process discipline; documentation completeness; time management
* **Shift timing:** Day shift
* **Education Qualification:** BCom

  

Pro\-tip : Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.
* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*


You’ll achieve more at HSBC


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

The preferred candidate should be someone who can Have hands\-on experience with Fresh / Repeat loan platforms such as **Bajaj, Fibe, Moneyview** and similar platforms.

**Role Objective**:\-  
We are looking for an experienced **TL /** **Sr. TL** who can independently manage and grow the **Fresh** / **Cold Lead Personal Loan Business**. The candidate should have strong experience in managing sales operations, cold lead conversion, team performance, and **data\-driven business strategies**.  
The ideal candidate should be capable of converting cold customer data into business opportunities through effective **data segmentation, calling strategy, lead prioritization, customer profiling, campaign planning, and performance monitoring**.  
Key Responsibilities1\. Business \& Team Management

* Manage the end\-to\-end Fresh / Repeat Loan Lead sales process.
* Lead and manage a team of callers / Sales Executives and ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
* Drive team productivity, conversion, revenue, and overall business performance.
* Set clear individual and team\-level KPIs.
* Conduct daily huddles, performance reviews, and target tracking.
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans.

2\. **Data Strategy \& Lead Management**

* Develop and execute **data strategies for Fresh / cold lead conversion**.
* Analyze customer data based on previous loan history, customer behaviour, loan eligibility, ticket size, tenure, repayment history, and previous offers.
* Segment data into high\-, medium\-, and low\-potential customer groups.
* Define **lead prioritization and calling strategies** to maximize conversion.
* Identify the best\-performing customer segments, calling time slots, campaigns, and data sources.
* Continuously test and improve different calling strategies based on conversion results.
* Work with MIS/Data teams to improve data quality and lead allocation.

3\. **Campaign \& Calling Strategy**

* Design calling strategies for different customer segments.
* Develop separate approaches for **hot, warm, and cold repeat\-loan customers**.
* Analyze disposition trends such as Not Interested, Low Offer, High ROI, Reduced Loan Amount, Customer Not Reachable, and Callback.
* Create effective rebuttals and sales strategies for customers who are not interested due to changes in loan offers.
* Identify opportunities to re\-activate customers who previously rejected or did not respond to the offer.
* Improve contact rate, conversion rate, login rate, approval rate, and disbursal rate.

4\. **Performance \& MIS Management**

* Track daily and monthly performance through dashboards/MIS.
* Monitor key metrics including:
* Data allocated vs. data called
* Contact rate
* Connect rate
* Interested rate
* Login rate
* Approval rate
* Disbursal rate
* Conversion rate
* Revenue
* Agent productivity
* Disposition\-wise performance
* Prepare daily/weekly business reviews and action plans.
* Identify trends and provide actionable insights to management.

5\. **Process Improvement**

* Identify gaps in the existing sales process and recommend improvements.
* Work closely with **Product, Data, Technology, Dialer, MIS, CRM, and Operations teams** to improve lead management and customer journeys.
* Define requirements for dialer campaigns, lead allocation, callbacks, disposition logic, API/data flow, and reporting.
* Use business data to improve overall campaign ROI.

6\. **People Management**

* Coach and mentor team members on sales skills, objection handling, and customer conversations.
* Conduct regular call audits and provide feedback.
* Identify top performers and replicate their best practices across the team.
* Manage underperformers through structured performance improvement plans.
* Ensure discipline, attendance, productivity, and adherence to process.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **3–5 years of experience** in sales/calling operations, preferably in **personal loans, repeat loans, lending, fintech, NBFC**
* Experience managing a team of **20\+ sales/calling executives** will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of **Fresh** / **cold lead management and conversion strategy**.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
* Proven experience in creating and executing **data\-driven sales strategies**.
* Strong understanding of sales funnels and conversion metrics.
* Good knowledge of **Excel, MIS, CRM, Dialer, and reporting tools**.
* Strong communication, leadership, coaching, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work with large datasets and identify actionable business insights.
* Target\-oriented and comfortable working in a high\-pressure sales environment.

The candidate should be able to answer:

* Which customer data should we call first and why?

* Why is conversion dropping?
* Which disposition is impacting business?
